create.name: Vincent Genna
create.bio:
Vincent Genna is an American psychic medium, spiritual teacher and author who brings a social worker's training to intuitive work. He took degrees in psychology and social work in Chapel Hill, and spent years in hospice care alongside more than five hundred dying patients and their families, an experience that shapes how he speaks about death and the continuity of the soul. A spontaneous awakening in his late twenties led him into mediumship and channelling, and he now offers private readings and spiritual mentoring by phone or in person.

His teaching sets psychology beside metaphysics: he looks at the unconscious patterns that hold people back from the lives they want, and at how the ego and the sacred can work together rather than against each other. He teaches psychic and mediumship development, animal communication and past-life exploration through Zoom courses, lectures and demonstrations, and has presented for groups such as IONS, IANDS and the A.R.E. He wrote The Secret That's Holding You Back, records guided meditations and talks, and hosts The Genna Effect podcast.

books.title: The Secret That's Holding You Back
books.author: Vincent Genna
books.description: Genna's book on the hidden layers of the mind that quietly protect old beliefs and stop people from acting on what they say they want. It mixes his psychology training with spiritual ideas and gives practical steps for noticing and loosening these patterns.

courses.title: The Soul Traveler: Past Lives and Life Between Lives (Zoom course)
courses.description: A four-week live course on Zoom, held on Tuesday evenings (Eastern time), exploring reincarnation, memories of earlier lives and the soul's time between incarnations. Genna guides the group through journeys and discussion aimed at understanding present patterns.

courses.title: Soul to Soul Psychic Medium Reading or Spiritual Counselling
courses.description: One-to-one sessions by phone or in person in which Genna works as a psychic and evidential medium, or offers spiritual mentoring. Sessions run for thirty or sixty minutes and are scheduled in Eastern time.

courses.title: 7 Journeys for Your Soul
courses.description: About three hours of guided meditations set to music, released as a download. The journeys cover self-belief, speaking with your soul, calming the mind, widening awareness and a conversation with the divine.

courses.title: God and Your Ego Are One
courses.description: A recorded lecture of about ninety minutes in which Genna argues that the ego is part of our spiritual make-up rather than an enemy to be crushed. He explains how caring for it can bring people closer to their sense of the divine.

courses.title: God, It's Not Working
courses.description: The full recording of Genna's lecture for people who have tried many self-help and spiritual methods without lasting change. He describes two parts of the mind that he believes block progress and how to work with them.

courses.title: Stop Stopping Yourself & Become Unstoppable
courses.description: A shortened recording of Genna's talk on the unconscious habits and beliefs that lead people to undermine their own plans. It offers ways to recognise these patterns and let them go.

free_resources.title: The Genna Effect Podcast
free_resources.description: Genna's free podcast, in which he talks through psychological, metaphysical and spiritual questions and interviews guests. Episodes are linked from his website.
